home.title: Your future starts here
home.subtitle: GlobalEarn supports African students preparing to study in Europe: a multi-country blocked account, Mobile Money to fund the application from your home country, AI-assisted housing search, combined insurance, and career support all the way to settling in.
home.illustrationTitle: Illustration of a student mobility journey between Africa and Europe
home.whySubtitle: A platform designed for the realities of funding and mobility from Africa, not a simple adaptation of a service built for Europe.

mobileMoney.title: Native Mobile Money
mobileMoney.description: MTN, Orange Money and Wave integrated directly, without a costly and slow international transfer.

multiCountry.title: One account, several countries
multiCountry.description: A single blocked account covers several European destinations, without multiplying bank procedures.

presence.title: Physical presence in Africa
presence.description: Local offices to speak with someone in person, not just an app.

allInOne.title: Everything in one place
allInOne.description: Housing, insurance and career support brought together in one space, instead of spread across several providers.

verification.title: Instant consular verification
verification.description: Our API partnerships let embassies verify the transfer certificate in real time.

followUp.title: Support until you settle in
followUp.description: Support doesn't stop at the visa: we stay involved for housing and the first steps on the ground.

home.offersSubtitle: From a simple blocked account to full support, choose the level that fits your project.
home.offersLink: Compare the three plans in detail
home.ctaFinal: Ready to build your future abroad?

services.title: Our support plans
services.subtitle: Three levels designed for different needs: handle part of the process yourself, or hand the entire journey over to GlobalEarn.
services.ctaFinal: Need help choosing the right plan?

about.title: A team committed to your international success
about.subtitle: GlobalEarn is based in Cameroon and operates through licensed European banking partnerships to manage blocked accounts.
about.missionText: Making it easier for African students to access the best international academic opportunities through quality support covering the entire mobility journey.
about.visionText: To become a reference in Africa for international student support, through an offer that combines digital tools with local human presence.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: Seeking the best solutions for every student, without shortcuts.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Explaining every step clearly, with no hidden fees or conditions.

achievement.title: Academic success
achievement.description: Putting every student's success at the heart of our support.

humanSupport.title: Human support
humanSupport.description: Staying present before, during and after departure, not just at the point of sale.

mobileMoney.title: Native Mobile Money
mobileMoney.description: MTN, Orange Money and Wave integrated directly, where most players in the sector only accept international bank transfers.

multiCountry.title: Multi-country coverage
multiCountry.description: A single blocked account for several European destinations, rather than reopening an account for each new country.

presence.title: Physical presence in Africa
presence.description: Local offices for trustworthy support, in a sector where human relationships still matter most.

verification.title: Instant consular verification
verification.description: API partnerships let embassies verify the transfer certificate in real time.

about.presenceText: Based in Cameroon, GlobalEarn operates through licensed European banking partnerships to manage blocked accounts and supports students toward several destinations in Europe.
